_about.purpose: Labeled retrieval set. Each question names the chunk(s) that actually contain the answer, so Recall@k and MRR measure whether the right resume passage reached the generator.
_about.labeling_rule: A chunk is relevant only if a correct spoken answer could be produced from that chunk alone. Chunks that merely mention the topic are not relevant. Labels were written by reading data/chunks.json, not by running the retriever.
_about.categories: education | project | project_tech | experience | paraphrase | publication | skills | certifications | location | unanswerable
_about.unanswerable_rows: relevant_chunks is empty on purpose. These are scored separately and excluded from Recall/MRR; they exist to measure the score separation the similarity gate depends on.
